cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Admit I found the restaurant. You can keep credit for the whole holiday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also complained about the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Different claim. I'm not filing it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. The rest of your glorious itinerary remains untouched.

confusable: D201 seeks full contribution detail; D204 explicitly limits the concession and leaves other victories alone.
comparison: Personal attribution and a caption differ from a sports call entry.
seedUse: Keep B's concession but give it a bounded condition for A to honor, not a sarcastic closing summary.
